### Element System (Phase 22 — Mar 25)
- **5 elements**: Fire, Earth, Arcane, Shadow, Chaos (neutral)
- **Type chart** (`arena-config.json` → `elementConfig.chart`): Fire > Earth > Arcane > Shadow > Fire. Chaos = neutral (no strong/weak)
- **Strong matchup**: +25% damage (configurable via `strongMult`). **Weak matchup**: -25% damage (`weakMult`)
- **Element passives** (applied in `handleStart`):
  - Fire: Ignite — all crits apply burn (not just strike crits). 8% maxHP × 2 rounds
  - Earth: Bedrock — +5% damage reduction passive
  - Arcane: Attunement — +1 starting charge (respects max cap)
  - Shadow: Phantom — +5% dodge chance
  - Chaos: Flux — random element each round (rolled in `resolveRound`)
- **Element sources**: card `element` field (set in Quick Build), fallback to `classDefaults` in config, fallback to `chaos`
- **Boss elements**: stored in `arena-bosses.json` (`element` field on each boss). All 14 bosses have assigned elements.
- **Pre-fight overlay**: shows boss element with matchup info
- **Card renderer**: element glow on card border, element badge
- **Move buttons**: element tint on hover/active
- **`resolveRound` receives `battle` as 9th parameter** — needed for ward/burst/prism state. Always default `battle = battle || {}`.
- **`elementState` in round result**: `{ ward, burst, elements, prismActive }` — client reads to update UI

**Elemental consumable items** (server-integrated, `handleMove` in `blindspotbattle/index.js`):
- Element Ward (`element_ward`) — negate elemental weakness for 3 rounds. Decrements each round it blocks.
- Element Burst (`element_burst`) — next elemental hit deals +50% bonus. Amplifies strong matchup OR grants +50% on neutral. Wasted on weak matchup.
- Element Shift (`element_shift`) — change your element to the one strong vs opponent. Uses `chart` to find counter.
- Prism Shard (`prism_shard`) — become chaos (element-neutral). Suppresses Chaos Flux rolling (`battle.prismActive.player = true`).

**Element resist charms** (4 charms, server-integrated via `equippedElementCharm` in battle start):
- Fire/Earth/Arcane/Shadow Ward Charm — -15% incoming elemental damage when opponent has strong matchup
- Sent as `equippedElementCharm` (element string) in battle start payload, stored as passive with `effect: 'element_resist'`
- Reduces `strongMult` from 1.25 to 1.10 (25% → 10% bonus)

- **Phase 22: Element System (Mar 25)** — Full elemental system: 5 elements (Fire/Earth/Arcane/Shadow/Chaos), type chart (Fire>Earth>Arcane>Shadow>Fire, Chaos neutral), element passives (Fire ignite, Earth DR, Arcane +1 charge, Shadow dodge, Chaos flux), element picker in Quick Build, element glow on cards, element matchup in pre-fight overlay, move button element tint. 4 elemental consumable items (Ward, Burst, Shift, Prism Shard) server-integrated. 4 element resist charms (-15% incoming). Prefight selector splits charms (pick 1) vs items (pick up to 3). Inventory items usable in campaign boss fights (not just adventures). All 14 bosses assigned elements. `resolveRound` takes `battle` as 9th param for ward/burst/prism state. `elementState` in round result response.

- **Phase 23: Combat Rebalance (Mar 31)** — Complete overhaul of combat math. HP formula reduced (`60 + END×5 + STR×1`, was `80 + END×7.5 + STR×1.5`). Strike damage +67% (`STR×0.5`, was `STR×0.3`). Heal -30% (`END×0.35`, was `END×0.5`). Stamina pool halved (`14 + END×0.5`, was `20 + END×1`), regen halved (`1 + END/10`, was `2 + END/5`), exhaustion threshold raised to 5 (was 3). Stranger card nerfed from 68→50 stat points. Boss progression smoothed: HP ramps 118→147 across 10 bosses. Berserker bosses (Brute/Feral/Revenant) STR trimmed. Gatekeeper: removed strike resistance, added strike/ability weakness, DR 10→fades fast. All 3 battle engines synced (campaign, async PvP, live PvP). Gatekeeper art replaced (`Gatekeeper-01.webp`). Stranger win now auto-beats Boss 1 via localStorage. Target fight length: 10-15 rounds (was 40+).
- **SEO Pass (Mar 31)** — OG image (`blindspot/img/og-blindspot.png`), Twitter cards, VideoGame JSON-LD schema on index.html. Canonical URLs on all pages. Sitemap entries added. robots.txt updated. login.html set to noindex.

### Remaining Roadmap (9/10 initiative — see `ROADMAP.md`)
- **Tournaments + friends (3C-3D)** — Social growth, now that async PvP infra exists
- **Card personality + constrained creation (2C-2D)** — Identity depth after loop proven
- **Polish + juice (5A-5D)** — Screen shake, particles, sound design pass

### Test Infrastructure
- `blindspot/tests/run-all.js` — runs smoke + unit tests together
- `blindspot/tests/smoke-test.js` — 23 structural checks
- `blindspot/tests/unit-tests.js` — 83 pure function tests (Elo, rarities, passives, loot)
- `blindspot/tests/player-flow-tests.js` — Playwright full player flow (43 checks)
- `blindspot/tests/visual-test.js` — Playwright screenshots at 375px + 1440px
- `blindspot/tests/player-simulator.js` — Playwright click-through on live site
- `blindspot/tests/api-contract.js` — boss data + battle API validation (12 checks)
- `blindspot/tests/diff-review.js` — git diff quality checks

### Key Lessons Learned
- `.bs-screen` has `max-width: 720px` — must override per-screen for wider layouts
- Always read existing CSS cascade before adding overrides
- `::before`/`::after` pseudo-elements can create ghost visual artifacts — verify at rest + hover
- `TIMEOUT` variable was scoped inside one function but referenced in another — caused ReferenceError
- Playwright is installed but browsers need `npx playwright install chromium`
- Visual test screenshots must be READ (via Read tool) not just captured — agent is multimodal
- **localStorage QuotaExceededError** can cascade through the entire game — every setItem must use `safeLSSet()`
- **CSS class mismatches between templates and JS queries** are silent killers — template renders one class, JS queries another, nothing works but no error is thrown
- **Loading gates need catch-all dismissal** — any uncaught error in init can leave the gate permanently visible
- **Duplicate `var` declarations** silently overwrite — use unique names (e.g. `CRATE_RARITY_COLORS` vs `RARITY_COLORS`)
- **Null guards on data-dependent rendering** — `getWeeklyBoss()` can return null if data fetch fails, guard before accessing properties
- **CSS grid named areas can't share rows** — two children can't stack in one named area; use a wrapper div with `display: contents` on mobile and `display: flex` on desktop
- **Re-rendering grids causes image flash** — use in-place DOM manipulation (class toggle, element swap) instead of `innerHTML` replacement when grid contains images
- **Card data lives in 3 save paths** — CardForge nests in `cardData.design`, Blindspot Forge puts at top level, server returns nested. Always check all three locations.
- **`min-height: calc(100vh - Xpx)` causes scroll** — use flex layout with `flex: 1` on the expanding section instead of viewport-based min-height calculations
- **Flip card container height is load-bearing** — the clone-and-scale preview mechanism in Quick Build calculates scale from container `offsetHeight`. Changing the container height breaks the card reveal. Don't touch the 480px/400px/350px values.
- **CSS rules defined later in the same file win the cascade** — the nameplate had 4 definitions across blindspot.css; the last one (with `margin-top: -2rem`) was overriding all earlier fixes. Always search for ALL definitions of a selector before adding overrides.
- **Parallel fetches complete in unpredictable order** — don't use array indexing for progress labels when fetches run via `Promise.all`. Each `.then()` should pass its own label directly.
- **Battle container on index.html has no topbar** — play.html has `bs-topbar` but index.html's `#bs-battle-container` was missing it. Added in Phase 10.
- **Rarity selector removed from Quick Build** — rarity is earned through forge visits (3/8/15/25), not player choice. Identity step shows read-only "Common" with hint text.
- **CardForge decoupling complete** — all CSS, JS, images, audio forked into Blindspot-owned files. Only card save API remains shared (product-agnostic).
- **bs-config.js must always use production API base URL** — Live Server (VS Code) can't proxy `/api/*` routes. Using relative `/api` path breaks local dev. Always use `https://ambientpixels-nova-api.azurewebsites.net/api`.
- **Lobby onboarding spotlight needs visible targets** — `box-shadow: 0 0 0 9999px` creates full-screen blackout if target element has zero size. Always check `offsetHeight > 0` and `getBoundingClientRect()` before positioning.
- **Card reveal celebration must show for ALL players** — don't gate the celebration moment behind auth status. Show reveal first, then offer sign-in vs guest choice.
- **Loading bar must animate smoothly** — jumping in 25% increments feels broken. Use `requestAnimationFrame` to ease toward target. Add rendering phase steps (85%, 95%) so bar fills continuously before gate dismisses.

- **Prefight overlay has 3 code paths — use `populatePrefightOverlay(boss)`** — enterArena (lobby Play button), campaign ladder (Replay buttons), and tower each open the prefight. All must call the shared function. Never inline prefight population code.
- **Cosmetic frame CSS animations override card slide animations** — frame classes (bs-frame--*) define `animation` properties that win via cascade order over slide classes. Slide animations use `!important` to guarantee they fire. Any new frame animation must not use `!important` on `animation`.
- **`equipCosmetic()` does NOT sync to server** — it only updates local `_progress.equipped`. Callers must explicitly call `syncProgressToServer()` after equip/unequip operations.
- **Ladder connectors need both dot AND line** — `bs-ladder-connector` is the vertical line (via `background`), `::before` is the dot. Both need color set for defeated (`--bs-success`) and default (`--bs-border`) states.
- **Adventure items are server-integrated, charms are mostly client-only** — items use `useItem` in move payload with real damage/heal effects. Charms show visual chips client-side (except element resist charms which add a server passive). Items come from two sources: adventure encounters and inventory picks (prefight selector). Both merge into `adventureItems` in battle start payload.
- **`window._pendingItemUse` bridges two IIFEs** — `blindspot-flow.js` sets it on item button click, `bs-arena-battle-ui.js` reads it in `handleMoveClick()`. Must be on `window` since they're separate scopes.
- **Adventure overlay must show BEFORE hiding pre-fight overlay** — prevents flash of underlying campaign screen between overlays.
- **`setupPrefightButtons()` replaces the `#bs-prefight-go` button with a wrapper div** — must restore the original button structure via MutationObserver when overlay hides, or next boss fight won't find the button.
- **Stat-gated choice filtering needs a safety minimum** — always ensure at least 2 choices visible. If all choices have `requires` and player doesn't meet any, fall back to ungated choices.
- **Adaptive DC must clamp** — without clamping, a 400-power card faces DC +2 which is fine, but an extreme edge case could push DCs to 20+ (impossible). Clamp offset to [-2, +3].
- **`.bs-overlay` needs `overflow-y: auto` only at mobile breakpoints** — adding it at desktop base causes scroll on overlays that should fit viewport. Use 2-column layout instead for content-heavy overlays (combat guide).
- **`window.scrollTo(0,0)` in `showScreen()`** — lobby scroll position carries over to battle, hiding the header. Always reset scroll on screen switch.
- **`body.bs-battle-active` needs `overflow: hidden`** — prevents scrollbars during battle on desktop. Also set `height: 100vh` on `.bs-play`.
- **Exhaustion damage-reduction makes fights LONGER, not shorter** — both sides deal less damage, fight drags to 25+ rounds. HP burn (% maxHP/round) accelerates endgame instead.
- **`::after` on `.arena-move-btn` is already used** — bottom accent line (line ~2033) and combo hint badge (line ~2210) both use `::after`. Cooldown clock overlay must use `::before` instead.
- **`conic-gradient` can't be CSS-transitioned** — transitions don't interpolate conic-gradient values. Snaps per round are fine for discrete turns. Don't add misleading `transition` declarations.
- **Cooldown decrement-then-set ordering matters** — decrement existing CDs first (on keys before new move added), then set new CD for move just used. The just-used move won't be decremented this round. This is correct behavior.
- **`arena-config.json` is the tuning bible** — stamina costs, regen, exhaustion, cooldown rounds, stance multipliers are all in config. Change config to tune, not code. Server caches config (`_configCache`) — cold restart needed for changes to take effect in prod.
- **Stance switch cost deducts before move resolves** — intentional design. A player with 2 stamina can switch to Aggressive (costs 2), then has 0 for their move → exhaustion burns HP. This is the "risky all-in" play, not a bug.
- **Stance multipliers compound on purpose** — dmgMult applies first (outgoing), then defMult applies to result (incoming). Both Aggressive = ×1.5 total. Document this so it doesn't look like a bug.
- **`resolveRound` parameter list is growing** — now takes `(player, opponent, playerMove, opponentMove, battleTempEffects, staminaState, stanceState, elements, battle)`. The 9th `battle` param is needed for ward/burst/prism state. Always default `battle = battle || {}` at top of element block. Only 1 call site (in `handleMove`), so safe to extend. Consider an options object if more params are needed.
- **Cached promise race conditions** — `fetchPrincipal()` cached the promise but the `.then` cleanup ran asynchronously, allowing another caller to grab the stale ref. Fix: compare `_principalPromise === thisPromise` before clearing. Pattern applies to any singleton promise cache.
- **Every `await apiFetch()` needs a timeout** — if `fetchPrincipal` or the API hangs, the caller hangs forever. Always wrap in `Promise.race` with a timeout + fallback (localStorage cache, empty array, etc.).
- **Progressive disclosure via `data-guide-tier` + CSS** — gate UI sections behind progression using `data-*` attributes + a parent tier class. CSS `[data-guide-tier] { display: none }` hides by default, tier class overrides. Re-evaluate tier on every open, not once. Reads localStorage (cosmetic feature, so drift from server is acceptable).
- **`bs-async-` battle ID prefix routes to async endpoint** — `bs-arena-api.js` checks `battleId.indexOf('bs-async-') === 0` to route `submitMove`/`forfeit` to `asyncBattle` vs `arenaBattle`. Never change this prefix without updating both client and server.
- **Defense queue auto-prunes after 7 days** — `STALE_DAYS = 7` in `blindspotdefensequeue/index.js`. Don't rely on stale entries; prune runs on every GET request.
- **Defender Elo K-factor is halved (K=16)** — `ELO_K_DEFENDER = 16` in `blindspotasyncbattle/index.js`. Defenders didn't choose the fight, so Elo changes are dampened.
- **Anti-farming 2hr cooldown is per-defender, server-side** — `CHALLENGE_COOLDOWN_MS` in `blindspotasyncbattle/index.js`. Checked via `lastChallengedBy` + `lastChallengedAt` on queue entry. Returns 429 with remaining minutes.
- **Defense queue snapshots card at registration** — `combatStats`, `badges`, `avatar` are copied into the queue entry. If player upgrades their card, they must re-register to update the snapshot.
- **JS state flags are lost on full page navigation** — `window.location.href` redirect resets all IIFE variables. Don't rely on in-memory flags (like `_isFirstRealFight`) to survive cross-page redirects. Use localStorage to persist state that must survive navigation.
- **Combat formula changes must be synced across 3 battle engines** — `blindspotbattle/index.js` (campaign), `blindspotasyncbattle/index.js` (async PvP), `blindspotlivebattle/index.js` (live PvP). All share the same HP, damage, and heal formulas. Miss one and PvP/PvE feel different.
- **Boss stat changes require 3 file updates** — `api/blindspotbattle/arena-bosses.json` (server battle), `api/blindspotbosses/arena-bosses.json` (display), `blindspot/data/bosses.json` (client campaign ladder). Miss one and the campaign UI shows stale data.
- **Stamina regen ≈ move cost = no tension** — if regen per round roughly equals the average move cost, stamina never drops and the system is decorative. Regen must be noticeably lower than cost (1-2 regen vs 4 cost) to create meaningful resource pressure.
- **Boss 1 must not have resistances** — new players only know Strike. A boss that resists strikes teaches "your only move doesn't work" as a first impression. Save resistances for Boss 3+.
- **Inbox polling uses `pollInboxCount()`** — called periodically from lobby to update the inbox badge. Returns unread count without loading full inbox data.

### Debug / Cheat Console (`window.BS`)
Exposed globally from inside the IIFE (bottom of `blindspot-flow.js`, just before BOOT). Open browser console on any Blindspot page and type `BS.help()` for full command list.

**Currency & Resources:**
- `BS.sparks(n)` / `BS.addSparks(n)` — set or add sparks
- `BS.forgeVisits(n)` — set forge visit count

**Progression:**
- `BS.setBoss(n)` — set highest boss beaten (1-10)
- `BS.setAscension(n)` — set ascension level
- `BS.setWins(n)` — set total wins
- `BS.setStreak(n)` — set win streak
- `BS.setPvpElo(n)` — set PvP Elo

**Charms & Items (consumables):**
- `BS.addCharm(id, n)` — add n to inventory (default 1). Works for all consumable pools.
- Charm IDs: `charm_heal_potion`, `charm_power_surge`, `charm_shield_wall`, `charm_lucky_strike`, `charm_charge_boost`, `charm_resist_fire`, `charm_resist_earth`, `charm_resist_arcane`, `charm_resist_shadow`
- Item IDs: `stamina_potion`, `endurance_tonic`, `second_wind`, `element_ward`, `element_burst`, `element_shift`, `prism_shard`
- `BS.charms()` — list owned charms/items with counts
- `BS.clearCharms()` — remove all
- `BS.charmList()` — show all available IDs + descriptions

**Crates:**
- `BS.addCrate(type)` — add crate: `battle`, `boss`, `weekly`, `ember`, `ascension`
- `BS.crates()` — list pending crates

**Cosmetics:**
- `BS.addCosmetic(id)` — unlock cosmetic (e.g. `frame_dragon_scale`, `back_void`, `plate_royal`)
- `BS.equip(slot, id)` — equip to slot: `frame`, `back`, `nameplate`, `victory`, `title`
- `BS.unequip(slot)` — clear a slot
- `BS.cosmeticList()` — show all IDs by category
- `BS.inventory()` — owned + equipped summary

**Visual Unlocks:**
- `BS.unlockPalette(name)` — unlock palette: `earth`, `ocean`, `neon`, `fire`, `monochrome`, `sunset`, `inferno`, `frost`
- `BS.unlockContainer(name)` — unlock container: `masked`, `fullbleed`, `framed`, `hero`

**Utility:**
- `BS.status()` — full progress snapshot
- `BS.godMode()` — 9999 sparks, all bosses, 3x every charm/item (incl. elemental + resist), all cosmetics, all palettes, 4 crates
- `BS.refresh()` — re-render lobby after changes
- `BS.reset()` — wipe all progress (with confirm dialog)

All commands auto-sync to server (1s debounce). Use `BS.refresh()` to update the lobby UI after changes.

# Pixel Agents & Agent Forge Development Reference

Pixel Agents is an AI agent marketplace where users deploy specialized agents for one-shot tasks. Agent Forge is the visual builder that lets users create custom agents with AI-generated portraits. Both run on Azure Static Web Apps with Azure Functions APIs.

## Recent Changes

_Changelog maintained by CEO. Agents should read this first — it reflects the most recent state of Pixel Agents and may contradict older sections below. The sync script pulls this section to the top of every injected skill block. Entries older than 30 days get condensed into the main skill body._

_No recent entries. CEO: add dated bullet points here as Pixel Agents evolves (new agents added/removed, pricing changes, Agent Forge builder updates, auto-approve tuning, etc.)._

## Quick Orientation

**Pixel Agents Frontend:** `ambientpixels/pixel-agents/` — catalog, run, analytics pages
**Agent Forge Frontend:** `ambientpixels/agent-forge/` — visual card pipeline builder
**APIs:** `ambientpixels/api/pixel-agent-*` + `agentforge-*` — 20 Azure Function endpoints
**Agent Registry:** `ambientpixels/pixel-agents/data/pixel-agents.json` + `ambientpixels/api/_data/pixel-agents.json` (MUST stay in sync)
**AI Models:** Claude Sonnet 4.6 (text analysis) + Gemini 2.5 Flash (image generation)
**Portrait Scripts:** `ambientpixels/scripts/generate-agent-portraits.js` + `generate-ambientos-portraits.js`

## Architecture Overview

```
Pixel Agents Catalog (/pixel-agents/)
├── index.html — agent card grid with source tabs + category filters + sort + trending
├── run.html — individual agent execution page (tier-aware redesign + share card button)
├── analytics.html — creator analytics + payout dashboard
├── docs.html — documentation (agent building, output types, rate limits, revenue share)
├── faq.html — FAQ with <details>/<summary> accordion
├── changelog.html — version history timeline
├── contact.html — contact form (hooks into formIntake API)
├── js/pixel-agents-ui.js — catalog logic, spotlight, carousel, filters, grid, trending
├── js/pixel-agent-run.js — agent execution, result rendering, share cards
├── js/pixel-agent-analytics.js — analytics + payout status + leaderboard + history
├── css/pixel-agents-design-system.css — design tokens + scoped resets
├── css/pixel-agents-layout.css — app shell grid + responsive + sidebar resources
├── css/pixel-agents-components.css — hero, spotlight, carousel, cards, badges, trending
├── css/pixel-agent-run.css — run page styles + share modal
├── css/pixel-agent-analytics.css — analytics + earnings + leaderboard + payout styles
├── css/pixel-agent-card.css — agent card component
├── img/ — 24 Arcane-style agent portraits (1024x1024 PNG)
└── data/pixel-agents.json — agent registry (frontend copy)

Agent Forge (/agent-forge/)
├── index.html — 3-column builder (tray, pipeline canvas, preview)
├── js/agent-forge.js — builder logic, drag-and-drop, state, portrait generator, edit mode
└── css/agent-forge.css — builder styles (fully token-migrated)

Azure Functions API (20 endpoints)
├── pixel-agent-run — Execute agent (Claude + optional Gemini/search/fetch) + creator attribution
├── pixel-agent-catalog — List agents with usage stats + 7-day trending (recentStats)
├── pixel-agent-review — AI gatekeeper (quality/uniqueness/safety scoring)
├── pixel-agent-submit — Save submission + trigger review + auto-approve (cap: 5)
├── pixel-agent-community — List approved community agents
├── pixel-agent-approve — CEO approve/reject (handles edits, cap: 5)
├── pixel-agent-remove — Delete community agent
├── pixel-agent-analytics — Creator stats + earnings + leaderboard + payout history
├── pixel-agent-checkout — Stripe checkout session
├── pixel-agent-billing-webhook — Stripe webhook handler
├── pixel-agent-entitlements — Query user billing status
├── pixel-agent-share-card — Server-side OG image generation (satori + resvg, 1200x630 PNG)
├── pixel-agent-share — HTML page with OG meta tags for social unfurling
├── pixel-agent-creator-onboard — Stripe Connect Express account creation + onboarding URL
├── pixel-agent-creator-status — Creator's Connect enrollment + payout readiness
├── pixel-agent-connect-webhook — Stripe Connect webhooks (account.updated, transfer.failed)
├── pixel-agent-payout-run — CEO manual payout trigger (dry-run or execute)
├── pixel-agent-payout-timer — Monthly auto-payout (6 AM UTC, 1st of month)
├── pixel-agent-payout-admin — CEO admin view (all creators, all payout runs, dry-run/execute)
├── agentforge-drafts — Per-user draft CRUD (blob storage)
├── agentforge-portrait — AI portrait generation (Gemini)
├── pixel-agent-run/smoke-test.js — 22 automated tests
└── _data/pixel-agents.json — agent registry (API copy)

Stripe Libraries (api/_lib/stripe/)
├── stripeClient.js — Core Stripe API client (raw axios, no SDK)
├── productCatalog.js — 8 products (PA Pro monthly/yearly, credits, CF/SF Pro)
├── entitlements.js — Per-user entitlements at billing/entitlements/{userId}.json
├── stripeConnect.js — Connect Express API (createAccount, accountLink, transfer, balance)
├── creatorProfiles.js — Creator profile CRUD via companyStorage
├── payoutCalculation.js — Snapshot delta, Pro subscriber scan, pool math, weighted distribution
└── payoutExecutor.js — Full payout execution flow (idempotency, balance check, transfers)
```

## Agent Registry (24 built-in + community agents)

Agents are defined in JSON:
```json
{
  "id": "agent-id",
  "name": "Display Name",
  "tagline": "Short description",
  "category": "tools|audit|design|...",
  "tier": "common|uncommon|rare|epic|legendary",
  "icon": "fas fa-icon-name",
  "capabilities": ["Cap 1", "Cap 2"],
  "inputType": "textarea|url",
  "inputValidation": "text|url",
  "systemPrompt": "You are...",
  "userPromptTemplate": "Do this: {{input}}",
  "outputSections": [{ "key": "score", "label": "Score", "type": "score" }],
  "generationConfig": { "temperature": 0.8, "maxOutputTokens": 1500 }
}
```

### Special Agent Flags
- `"webSearch": true` — calls Brave Search API before Claude
- `"fetchUrl": true` — fetches actual page HTML for URL inputs
- `"imageGeneration": true` — after Claude analysis, calls Gemini to generate image
- `"rateLimitCost": 2` — image agents cost 2 runs

### Output Section Types
score, verdict, text, list, tags, highlight, image, color_palette, name_list

## Agent Categories (12)
audit, content, strategy, naming, pitch, design, lifestyle, tools, career, intel, gaming, creative

## Rate Limits

| Limit | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Agent runs (anonymous) | 5/day per IP |
| Agent runs (authenticated) | 25/day per userId |
| Agent submissions | 5/day |
| Portrait generation | 10/day per user |
| Live agent cap | 5 per user |

Rate limit keys: anonymous uses IP hash (`ipHash_YYYY-MM-DD`), authenticated uses userId (`userId_YYYY-MM-DD`). Separate buckets — logging in resets allowance. CEO (`x-company-secret: pixelpusher`) bypasses all limits.

## API Execution Flow (pixel-agent-run)

```
Request → Validate agent → Extract user identity (cfAuth) → Rate limit check →
  → [if webSearch] Brave Search API →
  → [if fetchUrl] Fetch page HTML, strip to text →
  → Build prompt (template + search + site context) →
  → Call Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-6) →
  → Parse JSON response →
  → [if imageGeneration] Call Gemini via imageEngine →
  → Store run record (with userId + creatorId) → Update stats + creatorStats → Return result
```

## Auto-Approve System

When agents are submitted:
1. AI gatekeeper scores quality, uniqueness, safety (0-100 each)
2. All scores >= 70 → **auto-approved**, goes live immediately
3. Any score < 70 → forwarded to CEO approval queue
4. Any score < 40 → rejected outright

## Edit Gates (Live Agent Editing)

Click edit (pen icon) on live agents in sidebar → loads config into builder.

**Can change freely (no review):** tagline, description, icon, portrait, tier, temperature, max tokens
**Locked (disabled in edit mode):** name, category, system prompt, user prompt template, input type, output sections, powers

Cosmetic-only changes apply instantly. Name and agent ID are immutable after approval.

## Portrait Generator

Endpoint: `POST /api/agentforge-portrait`

Two modes via `mode` parameter:

### Agent Portraits (`mode: 'agent'` — default)
Style locked to Arcane League of Legends. Selectors:
- **Archetype**: Scholar, Operative, Executive, Creative, Technician, Mystic, Rebel, Guardian
- **Expression**: Confident, Intense, Friendly, Mysterious, Fierce, Calm
- **Appearance**: Masculine, Feminine, Androgynous, Non-human
- **Age**: Young (20s), Mid (30s), Mature (40s), Elder (50s+)
- **Color Accent**: None, Blue, Purple, Gold, Red, Green, Teal, Silver

### Creator Avatars (`mode: 'avatar'`)
Simple flat cartoon illustration style (distinct from agent portraits). Selectors:
- **Appearance**: Masculine, Feminine, Androgynous
- **Expression**: Confident, Friendly, Calm, Intense, Mysterious
- **Age**: Young, Mid, Mature, Elder
- **Style** (`avatarStyle`): Casual, Professional, Creative, Techy, Formal
- **Color Accent**: None, Blue, Purple, Gold, Teal, Silver

Avatar mode skips archetypes (no suits/armor), uses casual clothing by default. Output centered on face for circular crop.

All portraits uploaded to blob as WebP (community agents + avatars). Built-in agent portraits served from `/pixel-agents/img/{id}.webp`.

## Community Agent Discovery

Catalog page has three filter layers:
1. **Source tabs**: All / Built-in / Community (cyan accent)
2. **Category tabs**: All / Audit / Content / ... (purple accent)
3. **Sort dropdown**: Featured / Trending / Most Runs / Newest / Name A-Z

Community tab auto-switches to "Newest" sort. Empty state links to Agent Forge.

## Trending System

- Catalog API returns `recentStats` (7-day per-agent run counts from `pixelAgentRuns`)
- Cards show fire badge when 7-day runs >= 5
- "Trending" sort option orders by 7-day activity
- Spotlight widgets include dynamic "Trending Agents" widget (top 3 this week)

## Agent of the Day

- Deterministic daily spotlight rotation: `spotlightIndex = dayOfYear % spotlightAgents.length`
- Badge: "Agent of the Day" (replaces "Featured Prototype")
- Section label: "Daily Spotlight / Agent of the Day"
- Timer rotation still works after initial daily pick

## Shareable Result Cards

- `POST /api/pixel-agent-share-card?run=RUNID` — generates 1200x630 PNG via satori + @resvg/resvg-js
- `GET /api/pixel-agent-share?run=RUNID` — returns HTML with OG meta tags for social unfurling
- OG image auto-shows agent name, tier, score, verdict
- Share Card button on run.html result actions
- Font: SpaceGrotesk-Bold.ttf bundled in share-card endpoint directory

## Creator Analytics (/pixel-agents/analytics.html)

- Auth-gated page at Activity nav link
- Fetches `GET /api/pixel-agent-analytics`
- Shows: summary cards (live agents, total runs, 7-day runs, pending count)
- Revenue Share Estimate card (total + 7-day earnings, "Preview" badge)
- Stripe Connect status card (enrollment state, pending balance, "Payouts Active" badge)
- Per-agent cards: portrait, name, total runs, 7-day runs, last run, est. earnings
- Creator Leaderboard: ranked by runs, medal badges, tier indicator (Free 1x / Pro 1.5x)
- Next Payout estimate: amount, date, share %, weight, $25 minimum warning
- Pro Upgrade CTA: "Earn 70% instead of 50%, 1.5x weight, unlimited agents — $12/mo"
- Payout History table: month, amount, status, transfer ID with copy button
- Pending agents section with "Pending Review" badges
- Empty state with Agent Forge CTA

## Run Page Design

- Tier-aware gradient header (legendary=gold, epic=purple, etc.)
- Input section wrapped in card surface
- Two-column result grid on desktop (900px+), score card full-width
- Staggered fadeInUp animation on result cards
- Agent portrait in loading state
- Related Agents section: 3 same-category agents (fills with others if < 3)

## v2 Design System

All tokens in `pixel-agents-design-system.css`, scoped under `.pa-shell`:

```
--pa-primary: #8F00FF     (violet — CTAs, active states)
--pa-secondary: #00F0FF   (cyan — source tabs, Neural Bridge)
--pa-tertiary: #FF00D4    (magenta — community badges)
--pa-success: #4ade80     --pa-warning: #fbbf24     --pa-danger: #f87171
--pa-primary-hover: #7a00e0
--pa-font-display: Space Grotesk
--pa-font-body: Manrope
--pa-font-mono: Courier New, Fira Code, monospace
```

**Specificity note**: `.pa-shell h1/h2/h3/h4 { margin: 0 }` and `.pa-shell p { margin: 0 }` in the scoped reset beat single-class selectors. When setting margins on headings/paragraphs inside the shell, prefix with `.pa-shell` to match specificity.

## Navigation (Consistent Across All Pages)

Sidebar: Explore, Agents, Forge, Vault (Soon), Activity → all pages have identical nav
Sidebar resources (below nav, above CTA): Docs, FAQ, Changelog, Contact
Footer: Pixel Agents, Agent Forge, StoryForge, CardForge, Blindspot
Bottom nav (mobile): Explore, Agents, Forge, Vault, Activity

## Smoke Tests

`api/pixel-agent-run/smoke-test.js` — 22 tests covering:
- Agent lookup (built-in, community, scaffold, custom test)
- Input validation (empty, invalid URL)
- Rate limiting (anonymous 5/day, CEO bypass, IP isolation)
- Response shape, run records, stats increment
- JSON parse fallback, Claude API errors, markdown fence stripping

Run: `node api/pixel-agent-run/smoke-test.js`

## Critical Implementation Notes

### Two JSON files must stay in sync
```bash
cp pixel-agents/data/pixel-agents.json api/_data/pixel-agents.json
```

### Frontend calls Function App directly
```javascript
function getApiBase() {
  return window.location.hostname.includes('ambientpixels.ai')
    ? 'https://ambientpixels-nova-api.azurewebsites.net/api' : '/api';
}
```

### User Identity & Authentication
- `api/_utils/cfAuth.js` — `extractUserInfo(req, context)` returns `{ userId, email, isAuthenticated, principal }`
- Checks `x-ms-client-principal` (Azure SWA injected) and `x-cf-auth-principal` (manually forwarded)
- Frontend forwards B2C auth: fetches `/.auth/me`, base64-encodes `clientPrincipal`, sends as `x-cf-auth-principal` header
- Azure Functions strips `x-ms-client-principal` from external requests — use `x-cf-auth-principal` instead
- `creatorId`, `creatorName`, `creatorEmail` stored on agent configs at submission time
- CEO backdoor (`x-company-secret: pixelpusher`) removed from all frontend code — backend only for CLI admin

### Creator Profiles
- Stored at `creatorProfiles/{userId}` via companyStorage
- Fields: `displayName`, `bio`, `avatarUrl`, `website`, `twitter` + Stripe Connect fields
- Endpoint: `GET/POST /api/pixel-agent-creator-profile`
- GET `?userId={id}` — public view (name, bio, avatar, agent count, total runs)
- POST — save own profile (auth required), avatar upload with WebP conversion (512x512)
- Profile card on analytics page with inline edit form + AI avatar generator
- Leaderboard shows `displayName` from profiles (fallback: `creatorName` from agent data → raw userId)

### Portrait images
- Built-in: `/pixel-agents/img/{agent-id}.webp` (converted from PNG, 97% smaller)
- Community: `portraitUrl` field on agent config (blob storage URL, WebP)
- Creator avatars: `creator-avatars/{userId}.webp` in blob storage
- AmbientOS: `/ambientos/img/{agent-name}.png` (generated by scripts/generate-ambientos-portraits.js)

## Key Files Summary

| `pixel-agents/index.html` | Catalog page |
| `pixel-agents/run.html` | Run page (tier-aware redesign) |
| `pixel-agents/analytics.html` | Creator analytics |

## Revenue Share Model

| Tier | Monthly | Pool Share | Run Weight | Live Agents |
|------|---------|------------|------------|-------------|
| Free Creator | $0 | 50% of their share | 1x | 5 |
| Pro Creator | $12/mo | 70% of their share | 1.5x | Unlimited |

- 40% of all PA Pro subscription revenue → monthly creator pool
- Your share = your weighted runs / total weighted runs that month
- Payouts via Stripe Connect Express, $25 minimum, monthly (1st of month)
- Below-threshold earnings roll over to next month
- `pixelAgentCreatorStats` blob tracks per-creator per-agent all-time run counts
- `payout-snapshots/{YYYY-MM}` stores monthly snapshot for delta calculation
- `payout-runs/{YYYY-MM}` stores full payout breakdown per run
- `payout-history/{creatorId}` stores per-creator payout history

## Stripe Connect Flow

1. Creator clicks "Connect Stripe" on analytics page
2. `POST /api/pixel-agent-creator-onboard` creates Express account + returns onboarding URL
3. Creator completes Stripe-hosted onboarding form
4. `account.updated` webhook fires → updates creator profile (payoutsEnabled, chargesEnabled)
5. Monthly timer (1st of month, 6 AM UTC) or CEO manual trigger runs payout
6. Payout engine: snapshot delta → pool math → balance check → Stripe Transfers
7. Creator profile updated with totalPaidOut, pendingBalance

- Auth check: unauthenticated users see "Sign In to Go Pro"
- Stripe checkout: Go Pro → Stripe hosted checkout → success/cancel redirect
- B2C auth principal forwarded to checkout endpoint

## Dynamic Operator Badge

Sidebar "Operator" label reflects subscription status:
- Not signed in → "Operator" (cyan dot)
- Signed in, Free → "Free Creator" (cyan dot)
- Signed in, Pro → "Pro Creator" (purple glowing dot)

# StoryForge — Development Skill

StoryForge is an AI-powered interactive fiction game at `ambientpixels/storyforge/`. Players pick a genre, create a character via a 3-step wizard, then play through branching narratives with skill checks, inventory, companions, and AI-generated scene art + narration.

For deep architectural details, module internals, and API specs, read `ambientpixels/storyforge/docs/SYSTEM.md`.

## Recent Changes

_Changelog maintained by CEO. Agents should read this first — it reflects the most recent state of StoryForge and may contradict older sections below. The sync script pulls this section to the top of every injected skill block. Entries older than 30 days get condensed into the main skill body._

_No recent entries. CEO: add dated bullet points here as StoryForge evolves (new genres, character wizard changes, narrative engine updates, companion system changes, etc.)._

## File Map

### Pages
- `storyforge/index.html` — Hub (landing page)
- `storyforge/play.html` — Play (wizard + gameplay) — **main page**
- `storyforge/gallery.html` — Gallery (shared adventures)

### JavaScript (in `storyforge/js/`)
| File | Lines | Role |
|------|-------|------|
| `adventure-engine.js` | 2,787 | **Core** — wizard, turns, scene render, choices, dice, bottom sheet, save/load |
| `adventure-ai.js` | 815 | Gemini API — story gen, image gen, portrait gen, TTS |
| `adventure-rpg.js` | 407 | Stats, XP, leveling, inventory, companions, combat |
| `adventure-audio.js` | 320 | Ambient music + SFX playback |
| `adventure-gallery.js` | 530 | Gallery cards, filters, detail view |
| `adventure-app.js` | 239 | Hub page logic |
| `adventure-entitlements.js` | 204 | Pro/free tier, daily limits, Stripe |
| `adventure-ui.js` | 189 | Shared utils: `$()`, `escapeHtml()`, toasts |
| `adventure-storage.js` | 166 | LocalStorage + server save/load |
| `adventure-tutorial.js` | 185 | First-run tutorial overlay |
| `adventure-share.js` | 59 | Share URL + clipboard |

Scripts load with `defer` in this order: audio → ui → rpg → storage → share → ai → entitlements → engine → tutorial. Each module exposes a global (`UI`, `AI`, `Ent`, `RPG`, `Audio`, `Storage`, `Share`) on `window`.

### CSS (in `storyforge/css/`)
| File | Lines | Scope |
|------|-------|-------|
| `adventure-base.css` | 417 | Design tokens (`--sf-*`), layout, header, buttons |
| `adventure-play.css` | 2,757 | Play screen (scene, choices, sidebar, dice, ending) |
| `adventure-responsive.css` | 471 | Mobile breakpoints (900/768/600/480px) — **loads last** |
| `adventure-particles.css` | 1,616 | Genre particle animations |
| `adventure-gallery.css` | 787 | Gallery grid + cards |
| `adventure-hub.css` | 512 | Hub landing styles |
| `adventure-effects.css` | 205 | Shared effects (glows, shimmer) |

CSS naming follows BEM-ish convention: `.adv-{block}__{element}--{modifier}`.

### API (in `api/`)
- `storyforgesave/` — Save game state
- `storyforgeload/` — Load saved game
- `storyforgegallery/` — List/submit shared adventures
- `storyforgeshare/` — Get shareable adventure data
- `storyforge-entitlements/` — Check pro/free tier
- `storyforge-checkout/` — Stripe checkout
- `storyforge-billing-webhook/` — Stripe webhook

### Data & Assets
- `storyforge/data/genres.json` — Genre config (prompts, stats, options, art style hints)
- `storyforge/audio/ambient/` — Genre-matched ambient music (MP3)
- `storyforge/audio/sfx/` — UI sound effects (MP3)
- `storyforge/images/` — Genre cards, banners (PNG/WebP)

## Critical Rules

### Cache busting
Azure SWA serves CSS/JS with a 7-day immutable CDN cache (`Cache-Control: max-age=604800, immutable`). Without cache-busting params, users won't see your changes for up to a week — even after a successful deploy. All `<link>` and `<script>` tags use `?v=YYYYMMDD[letter]` params. When you change any CSS or JS file, bump the version in **all three HTML pages** (play.html, index.html, gallery.html) in the same commit. This was a painful lesson — partial cache busting causes confusing inconsistencies.

Current: `?v=20260310c`

### CSS cascade
`adventure-responsive.css` loads last in the stylesheet chain. Because of CSS specificity rules, a bare selector later in the cascade beats an identical selector inside an earlier `@media` block. This means desktop-only hiding rules (like hiding the mobile bottom sheet handle) must be wrapped in `@media(min-width: 901px)` — a bare `display: none` will override the mobile `display: flex` and silently break mobile layouts.

### Design tokens
All colors come from `--sf-*` custom properties defined in `adventure-base.css :root`. Use these instead of raw hex/rgba values so the design stays consistent and themeable. Key tokens: `--sf-accent`, `--sf-bg-deep/surface/elevated`, `--sf-text/text-muted/text-dim`, `--sf-success/danger/warning/info`.

### Mobile bottom sheet
On screens narrower than 900px, the desktop sidebar becomes a fixed bottom sheet. Understanding this pattern prevents layout bugs on mobile:
- Collapsed: 110px tall showing drag handle + mini stats bar (HP/Turn/Gold)
- Handle + mini bar are injected by JS (`initBottomSheet()` in engine.js ~line 2737)
- Handle visibility is CSS-controlled: `display: flex` in `@media(max-width:900px)`, `display: none` in `@media(min-width:901px)`
- Tap or swipe expands to 70vh with all stat panels visible

### Responsive breakpoints
- **900px**: Column layout, sidebar → bottom sheet, hide immersive button
- **768px**: Wizard stats stack vertically
- **600px**: 2-col genre grid, hide wizard step labels, smaller text
- **480px**: Hide logo text, compact header, wrap audio controls, hide choice keys

### High blast-radius files
These files are large and interconnected — read them fully before editing, and keep changes minimal and focused:
- `adventure-engine.js` — orchestrates everything (2,787 lines)
- `adventure-play.css` — all play screen styling (2,757 lines)
- `adventure-responsive.css` — all mobile breakpoints (cascade-sensitive)
- `data/genres.json` — affects AI prompts, game balance, character options

## Common Tasks

### Add a new genre
1. Add entry to `data/genres.json` with all required fields (use fantasy as template)
2. Add genre-specific CSS in `adventure-play.css` (`.adv-app[data-genre="newgenre"] .adv-scene__image-wrap`)
3. Add genre particle variant in `adventure-particles.css`
4. Add 3-4 ambient music tracks to `audio/ambient/newgenre-*.mp3`
5. Add genre card image to `images/genre-newgenre.webp`
6. Bump `?v=` in all three HTML files

### Modify play screen layout
1. Read `adventure-play.css` for the section you're changing
2. Check `adventure-responsive.css` for all breakpoints that affect it
3. Test at 390px (iPhone 13), 768px (tablet), and 1200px+ (desktop)
4. Bump `?v=` in all three HTML files

### Modify game mechanics
- Stats/combat/inventory: `adventure-rpg.js`
- Turn flow/choices/scene: `adventure-engine.js`
- AI prompts: `adventure-ai.js` + genre prompts in `data/genres.json`
